title: Maple Leaf Cement’s revenues rise in 2026 fiscal year
summary: Maple Leaf Cement’s revenues rise in 2026 fiscal year
body_markdown: **Pakistan:** Maple Leaf Cement has reported a 24% year-on-year increase in revenues for the Pakistani fiscal year 2026, which ended on 30 June 2026. Revenues were US$307m, which was attributed to higher sales volumes and the inclusion of Pioneer Cement's sales following its acquisition. According to AKD Securities Limited, MLCF's profitability increased by 3% year-on-year, with net earnings of US$42.9m.
